newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade active at $63 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade active at $63 - USDA.

text.p: Trade turned fairly active in the Panhandle area late Tuesday morning and carried into the early afternoon, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were mostly $1.00 per cwt lower than last Thursday.

Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 19,200 slaughter steers and 11,400 heifers; 52,000 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 20,800 formulated and 100 head previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 63.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 63.00,
small pen North Plains 64.00. Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1050
Confirmed - 30,600 Week Ago - None Year Ago - 2,000
Wk to date - 52,000 Week Ago - 29,300 Year Ago - 19,800
